background.definition: One's social heritage, or previous life; what one did in the past.

predators.definition: Any animal or other organism that hunts and kills other organisms (their prey), primarily for food.

empty.definition: (usually plural) A container, especially a bottle, whose contents have been used up, leaving it empty.

weekend.definition: The break in the working week, usually two days including the traditional holy or sabbath day. Thus in western countries, Saturday and Sunday.

utilise.definition: To make use of; to use.

candidate.definition: A person who is running in an election.

trial.definition: An opportunity to test something out; a test.

impeachment.definition: The act of calling into question or challenging the accuracy or propriety of something.

conservatives.definition: A person who favors maintenance of the status quo.

context.definition: The surroundings, circumstances, environment, background or settings that determine, specify, or clarify the meaning of an event or other occurrence.

faction.definition: A group of people, especially within a political organization, which expresses a shared belief or opinion different from people who are not part of the group.

preservation.definition: The act of preserving; care to preserve; act of keeping from destruction, decay or any ill.

hardliners.definition: A person who takes a firm, uncompromising position on some policy.

reformists.definition: One who advocates reform (of an institution).

sources.definition: The person, place or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired.

warehouse.definition: A place for storing large amounts of products. In logistics, a place where products go to from the manufacturer before going to the retailer.

adopts.definition: To take by choice into relationship (a child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.)

crow.definition: A bird, usually black, of the genus Corvus, having a strong conical beak, with projecting bristles; it has a harsh, croaking call.

chicken.definition: A domestic fowl, Gallus gallus, especially when young.

rook.definition: A European bird, Corvus frugilegus, of the crow family.

magpie.definition: One of several kinds of bird in the family Corvidae

rotor.definition: A rotating part of a mechanical device, for example in an electric motor, generator, alternator or pump.

luxurious.definition: Very fine in quality and comfortable.

compensation.definition: The act or principle of compensating.

squatting.definition: To bend deeply at the knees while resting on one's feet.

bow.definition: A weapon made of a curved piece of wood or other flexible material whose ends are connected by a string, used for shooting arrows.

novella.definition: A work of prose fiction, longer than a novella.

gardening.definition: To grow plants in a garden; to create or maintain a garden.

digging.definition: To move hard-packed earth out of the way, especially downward to make a hole with a shovel. Or to drill, or the like, through rocks, roads, or the like. More generally, to make any similar hole by moving material out of the way.

increase.definition: An amount by which a quantity is increased.

drainage.definition: A natural or artificial removal of fluid from a given area by its draining away.

double.definition: Twice the number, amount, size, etc.

corresponding.definition: (constructed with to) To be equivalent or similar in character, quantity, quality, origin, structure, function etc.

degree.definition: A stage of proficiency or qualification in a course of study, now especially an award bestowed by a university or, in some countries, a college, as a certification of academic achievement. (In the United States, can include secondary schools.)
